headline: Amrize Shares Rise After Q3 Earnings Top EPS Estimates
summary: Amrize reported Q3 2026 earnings per share that surpassed analyst expectations, sending the company's shares higher.
why: Beating consensus EPS expectations serves as a key catalyst for short-term stock appreciation and validates execution of corporate strategy.

impacts.name: Amrize
impacts.why: Beating consensus EPS estimates directly drives upward share price movement.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Surpassing Wall Street profit expectations signals stronger-than-anticipated business execution, prompting buying pressure.
